label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 101 ]

blocks.text: For centuries there has been a tendency for us to think of health only in terms of physical bodies. The medical community did not look seriously at the possibility that our mind could play an important role in illness and healing. Recently, however, there has been a lot of research that proves our mind affects illness and healing. A medical center reported that a larger portion of their patients were people who did not have an organic disease but were seeking psychological help.

readingSentences.english: For centuries there has been a tendency for us to think of health only in terms of physical bodies.
readingSentences.korean: 수세기 동안 우리는 신체적인 몸이라는 측면에서만 건강을 생각하는 경향이 있어 왔다.

readingSentences.english: The medical community did not look seriously at the possibility that our mind could play an important role in illness and healing.
readingSentences.korean: 의학계는 우리의 마음이 병과 치료에 중요한 역할을 할 수 있는 가능성을 진지하게 생각하지 않았다.

readingSentences.english: Recently, however, there has been a lot of research that proves our mind affects illness and healing.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 최근에는 우리 마음이 병과 치료에 영향을 미친다는 것을 증명하는 많은 연구가 있다.

readingSentences.english: A medical center reported that a larger portion of their patients were people who did not have an organic disease but were seeking psychological help.
readingSentences.korean: 어떤 의료 기관에서는 환자의 반 이상이 어떤 신체 기관의 병을 가지고 있는 것이 아니라 심리적인 도움을 찾으려는 사람들이라고 보고했다.
